part.text:
Implemented the `v-for` shallow-reactive array fix in `packages/runtime-core/src/helpers/renderList.ts`.

`renderList` now only wraps array items with `reactive()` when the source is a deep reactive array. Items from a `shallowReactive` array stay raw, preserving nested refs as objects rather than unwrapping them through an unintended proxy.

Validated with:

- `pnpm test-unit packages/runtime-core/__tests__/helpers/renderList.spec.ts --run`
- `pnpm eslint packages/runtime-core/src/helpers/renderList.ts`
- `pnpm test-unit packages/runtime-core/__tests__ --run`
